image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on dark, decaying leaf litter. The amphibian has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular yellow-orange markings along its back and sides. The head is visible on the left, showing prominent parotoid glands, while the body curves towards the right. The skin appears wet and reflective.
